source.title: TOKYO TRAVEL VLOG 2026 🌸 our itinerary, food tour, tsukiji fish market, best coffee

hooks: Description lists the places in video order, starting with Dogenzaka Mammoth and Hikiniku to Come
Notes Sushi Hatsume is where Andrew went for omakase (description)
Calls it probably one of her longest videos (description)

message.subject: I listed your Tokyo vlog 2026 on one map
message.body:
Hi Kathy, I'm Adrian from PinWith, a map-list app.

Your list goes from Dogenzaka Mammoth and Hikiniku to Come all the way to Andrew's omakase at Sushi Hatsume, which made me hungry. I put 10 of the places into one map: https://pinwith.me/@pinwith_en/kathyjo-tokyo-vlog-2026

It's private for now: only this link opens it, and I'll delete it if you'd rather I didn't.

With PinWith, your viewers can follow in your footsteps: revisit the places you went or plan their own trip from one map, in their own language. That helps your content reach further.

If you like it, I'll move it to your account, credited to you, so you can link it under your videos. Lists like this can also earn curators extra income: https://pinwith.me/for-creators?lang=en
No reply needed if it's not useful.

Adrian
PinWith · pinwith.me
